title: Quarterly Tax Estimate Monthly Amount Trend
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=freelance:tax
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(tax_due_usd) as amount count as records by _time
| sort - _time
description: Trends the monthly dollar impact behind quarterly tax estimate so growth, slumps, and seasonality are obvious.
value: Month-level financial trending is the cleanest way to see whether a side hustle or household flow is genuinely changing.
implementation: Keep values normalized to a single currency before loading them into Splunk.
visualization: Column chart of monthly amount with record counts.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how the money behind quarterly tax estimate changes month by month.
